items.title: Peka B40 Screenings Reveal Undiagnosed Conditions Among Almost Half Of Participants
items.summary: Nearly 46% of 328,302 people screened by Peka B40 last year had either at least one previously undiagnosed NCD, identified as being at risk of anxiety or depression, or both. Peka B40 screening uptake as of Aug 31 varied from 15% in KL to 46% in Kelantan. items.title: Doctor No-Shows For Permanent Posts Hit Sabah, Sarawak
items.summary: On Sept 28, many medical officers (MOs) didn’t report for duty for permanent posts in Sabah and Sarawak. Doctors unofficially reported zero MOs showing up in at least four hospitals; other facilities in both states reportedly saw 70% to 76% no-shows.
